_note: rog-cc eye codes from 16-frame strips (stride 6), with the step-1 zone-pass count as a cross-check. NOT blind: f0 shows rest vs mid, and the hex->name map was printed during the run.
rc61_pend12_rest_s4: held (rod horizontal at the release point f0-f90)
rc61_pend14_mid_s4: swing (small-amplitude swing near the bottom f0-f90; bob rarely leaves the zone, so passes undercount; rod length varies)
rc61_pend12_rest_s5: no-swing-detach (whole rod+axle piece drifts diagonally down-left as a rigid object and lands on the table f84-90; never swings about the axle)
rc61_pend12_mid_s5: swing (continuous, faster/choppier than real: 16 zone passes vs real 6-7)
rc61_pend14_rest_s5: partial-dip (rod dips ~45-60 deg below horizontal on the robot side f18-48, goes back UP to horizontal f54-84 and holds, dips again f90; never passes the bottom)
rc61_pend12_rest_s6: no-swing-detach (rod lengthens into a long bar that slides diagonally down as a rigid object f12-60 and lies near the table; no rotation about the axle)
rc61_pend14_mid_s5: swing (small amplitude near the bottom; bob never leaves the zone, so passes undercount)
rc61_pend14_rest_s6: held (rod horizontal f0-f90; slight late shift of the rod near the gripper)
rc61_pend14_mid_s6: swing (continuous swing about the axle f0-f90, bob crosses the bottom repeatedly; 4 zone passes; rod length varies a little)
